description: Election Commission - Filling of a Vacancy in the Office of member of the Kandy Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in the office of a member of the Kandy Municipal Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process triggered by a member ceasing to belong to their political party and the subsequent nomination of a replacement. The content is specifically about an electoral process for a local authority, falling squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7).
